title: Financial Planning Analyst (FP&A)
description: Financial modeling, variance analysis, financial reporting, and budget forecasting for high-growth African fintech. Experience with Excel, financial statement analysis, and IFRS.

title: Finance & Accounting Intern (Paid)
description: Paid remote accounting internship. Perform bank reconciliations, process accounts payable, audit digital invoices, and assist with QuickBooks bookkeeping. Strong Excel required. Ideal for graduates or ICAN/ACCA student members.

title: Financial Reporting Accountant
description: Preparation of monthly financial statements in compliance with IFRS, ledger reconciliation, audit prep, and tax compliance (VAT, WHT, CIT). Requires Excel and QuickBooks/Xero proficiency.

title: Finance Accountant
description: Daily reconciliation, liquidity monitoring, and treasury operations in a fintech institution. Responsible for ledger integrity, regulatory returns, and financial reporting.

title: Junior Accountant / Virtual Bookkeeper
description: Entry-level junior accountant. Maintain accounts receivables/payables, daily bookkeeping using Xero/QuickBooks, and assist senior accountants with quarterly audits.

title: Accounting Intern (Paid Graduate Trainee)
description: Hands-on paid internship for recent accounting/finance graduates or NYSC corpers. Learn corporate tax filing, ledger posting, payroll administration, and invoice matching.
